findings.finding: The brief attributes faster pairs to secondary signal-timing interactions and the mean increase to corridor throughput without trajectory/mechanism-isolation evidence.
findings.correction: Report same-seed outcome differences with explicit denominators; planned route membership, congestion, stochastic rerouting and model events do not isolate a unique causal mechanism.

findings.finding: The brief attributes incompatible programs to legacy formatting against SUMO 1.28.0. The native warnings describe mutual signal conflicts, and the 1.19 probe also has 577 conflicts.
findings.correction: Treat actual signal/network compatibility as unresolved model quality requiring qualified repair and independent validation, not a format-only issue.

findings.finding: The text starts at 318 matched completions and then says two censored pairs plus one teleport pair are excluded to give 317.
findings.correction: Start with 320 scheduled pairs, exclude two censored to obtain 318 matched completions, then exclude one teleport-identified completed pair to obtain 317 eligible pairs.

findings.finding: The brief calls loaded/departed counts counters at that instant after a 30-second absolute TraCI advance.
findings.correction: Counters belong to that TraCI advance, which can span multiple native time steps; they are not one 0.25-second instantaneous count or whole-run totals.
